text: The Director, Arts and Culture Services, Economic Development and Culture will present an updated work plan for the Committee's consideration. On February 11, 2020, the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee requested the Director, Arts and Culture Services, Economic Development and Culture to update the Committee's work plan based on the comments and suggestions made during the discussion on Item FA2.6.
The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee adopted the Revised Draft Work Plan for the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee 2019-2022.
